findings.passage: When it comes to anything elections related in the legislature, we’ve seen attack after attack on voting rights, such as the elimination of the three-day grace period for mail-in ballots, the shortened advanced voting window, and the limits on which website domains can help people register to vote. Our focus on elections in the legislature should be on facilitating voter registration and making it easier for people to cast ballots.
findings.note: Answer to the Lawrence Journal-World primary questionnaire, posted on her campaign site (dated 2026-07-17 on the site's news list). She names the end of the mail-ballot grace period, a shorter advance voting window and limits on registration websites as restrictions on voting, and says elections work should make registration and casting a ballot easier. No mention of photo ID or citizenship proof.
